description:
Title: Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna

The robot receives an order.
It asks whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger.
If he wants a menu, the robot starts preparing the drink, which depending on the size can take a variable amount of time.
While doing so, he asks if you want fries or wedges.
If you want fries, he prepares the fries; if you want wedges, he prepares wedges.
Again the duration varies depending on the size fries/wedges order.
After that, he prepares the burger, and gives you enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds.
Depending on the number of ingredients, the duration for creating the burger varies.
Your order is delivered via a conveyor belt.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order received"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageED_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask whether customer wants a menu or just the burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>The robot asks the customer whether they want a menu or only the burger.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or burger only?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuSplit" name="Start menu preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask fries or wedges"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>

      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the fries order size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the wedges order size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Side prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuJoin" name="Menu components ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients. Runs while status updates are given every 30 seconds.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Timer_StatusUpdate" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">

      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven" name="Status update given"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04_BurgerOnly" name="Burger only" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ToBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ToBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ToBurger" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverViaConveyor" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdate" sourceRef="Timer_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdateGiven"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
